y.Distribution & Service Network: Extent of distribution channels, dealers, and service centers across India for sales and support. Evidence includes number of offices, partners, and coverage maps.
y.Market Share & Brand Strength: Market share in the Indian industrial fire safety market and brand recognition among key stakeholders. Evidence includes market reports, awards, and customer surveys.
